title: Fetching and Managing API Data (Axios, Fetch, React Query)
description: Learn to fetch and manage remote data in React using Fetch API, Axios, and React Query for efficient data handling and caching.

lessons.title: Introduction to API Calls in React
lessons.content: API calls let your React app communicate with servers to retrieve or send data, essential for dynamic applications.

lessons.title: Using Fetch API to Get Data
Handling Async/Await with Fetch
Introduction to Axios
lessons.content: Axios is a popular promise-based HTTP client with easier syntax, automatic JSON transformation, and better error handling.

lessons.title: Using Axios to Fetch Data
POST Requests with Axios and Fetch
Introduction to React Query
lessons.content: React Query simplifies fetching, caching, synchronizing, and updating server state in React applications.

lessons.title: Basic Data Fetching with React Query
React Query Features: Caching and Refetching
lessons.content: React Query caches API responses to improve performance and can automatically refetch data on interval or window focus.

lessons.title: Error Handling and Loading States in React Query
lessons.content: React Query provides built-in states for loading, errors, and success to simplify UI updates during API calls.
